newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Macmahon confident on record yr sales.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Macmahon confident on record yr sales.

text.p: Contract miner and construction group MacMahon Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was confident of achieving record revenues of about A$440 million for the year to June 30, 1997.

"The group had nearly A$640 million in work-in-hand as at December 31, 1996 and we are confident of a full year's turnover of around A$440 million," MacMahon's chief executive, Graeme Beissel said in a statement.
MacMahon earlier posted a 30 percent rise in net half earnings of A$10.45 million on revenue of A$227 million which was also 30 percent higher than the previous year.
Beissel said MacMahon had seen improvements in the opening half of 1996/97 across operations of the group with the company winning a number of key mining and civil contracts.

These included the A$100 million gold mining contract at Tarmoola in Western Australia on behalf of Mt Edon Gold Mines (Australia) Ltd, the A$25 million Southern Expressway contract in Adelaide and additional undergroud mining contracts in Western Australia and Tasmania.

Beissel said the group was looking forward to a strong overall result for 1996/97 based on further consolidation and controlled growth of the compnay's mining, quarrying and civil work throughout Australia and increasingly in South East Asia.
MacMahon shares closed three cents higher at A$1.16 on Friday.
